high_level_description: A beachfront restaurant terrace at Malvarrosa beach in Valencia at lunchtime, with a wide paella pan on the table and the sea beyond.

style_description.aesthetics: Warm, inviting vintage travel-poster illustration of Valencia, Spain; simple confident shapes, gentle grain, uncluttered composition, no lettering, no signs with words, no captions, no user interface.
style_description.lighting: Bright Mediterranean light with soft warm shadows.
style_description.art_style: Mid-century gouache travel poster with flat layered shapes, visible brush texture and a limited warm palette.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A wide pale sandy beach and calm blue Mediterranean under a bright sky, with a palm-lined promenade.

elements.desc: A wooden table with a large shallow paella pan of golden rice with green beans and chicken, lemon wedges and two plates.
A waitress in a white shirt and long dark apron holding a notepad, smiling.
A striped awning in white and blue shading the terrace.
The beach and sea with a few tiny distant bathers and a sailing boat.
